name: Hesper Salcedo

background:
Born in Athkatla, Amn, Hesper Salcedo came from an unremarkable family of modest means. His childhood offered little indication of the path his life would eventually take.

As a young man, Hesper entered the service of the Dark Ravens, a secretive order of monastic assassins descended from the traditions of the Black Raven Monastery. Under their harsh discipline, he learned to master his body and emotions, developing exceptional precision, patience and self-control. His training extended beyond martial combat into stealth, infiltration, poisons and the careful execution of contracted killings.

Hesper proved a capable student. He was methodical, intelligent and possessed little hesitation when carrying out his assignments. To him, killing was neither a pleasure nor a moral dilemma, but simply a task to be performed correctly.

Eventually, Hesper parted ways with the order. Having grown accustomed to a life in which his skills could command considerable payment, he found his way into the maritime underworld of the Sword Coast. There he took up piracy, discovering that the skills of an assassin translated remarkably well to life aboard a ship. Over time, he also developed a talent for fighting with paired blades, complementing his monastic training with the practical techniques of a seasoned sailor.

A follower of Mask, Hesper considers deception, discretion and calculated opportunism essential virtues. He has little interest in unnecessary violence, preferring subtlety and efficiency wherever possible. His manner is unusually polite, even when dealing with enemies, and he rarely raises his voice.

Now forty years old, Hesper remains a disciplined and dangerous man. Though his days as a Dark Raven are behind him, the lessons of the monastery have never left him.

He is, above all else, a professional.
